div.div: مَا تَرَكُوا إِلَّا رِمْدَةَ حَتَّانَ , or حَتَّانٍ, (as in different copies of the K in art. رمد,) They left not of them so much as thou mightest rub thy hands therewith and then blow it away in the wind after rubbing it off. (K ubi suprà.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
